title: How to organize the dining table | Dining Room
description:
Seat everyone for a shared meal without having to move anything first.

This is the Dining Table in the Dining Room. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One centerpiece on bare wood and nothing else, every chair pushed all the way in with nothing hanging off its back, placemats and trivets in the sideboard drawer one step away, and no paper anywhere on the surface.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the whole table onto the floor in one armful, then sort what came off by owner rather than by type.
Straighten: Placemats, trivets, and the napkin basket belong in the nearest sideboard drawer, one step from where you set
Shine: Run a fingernail down the leaf seam and the joint where the top meets the pedestal, because that is where crum
Safety: Lift and rock each chair to find a loose rung or a joint that has started working, and turn any chair that mov
Standardize: The centerpiece is the table's only permanent resident and its footprint is the boundary.
Sustain: When the plates go to the sink after dinner, the homework, the mail, and the craft box ride along in the same

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Bare wood plus one centerpiece between meals, and every visiting activity arrives in its own container and leaves with it.
